description: Build an unsigned Panta buy transaction (Solana v0, base64, plus the raw instructions) for your own wallet to sign and broadcast. SiteCheck never signs, holds keys or custodies funds. Then report the signature to POST /api/markets/report (free). Price: $0.01 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

amountUsdc.description: USDC to spend, as a decimal string, e.g. "5.00"

id.description: Panta market id (the market's event address, base58), from GET /api/markets

wallet.description: The buyer's Solana wallet (base58). It pays and signs; SiteCheck never does.

name: markets_build_buy
title: Markets Build Buy
